description.text: Hubei University of Automotive Technology (HUAT) was founded in 1972 with Mr. Meng Shaonong, the former member of the Chinese Academy of Science appointed as its first president. It is being praised as the “Cradle of Automotive Engineers”. The Dongfeng-HUAT Formula 1 Team has won the Grand Champions in Formula Student China (FSC) three times.

duration.text: The Management at Hubei University Of Automotive Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Copy of Passport and Photo; 2.Diploma, Certificate and Transcript; 3.Bank Statement; 4.Application form; 5.Physical Examination Report; 6.Police Clearance 7.Study Plan 8. Recommend Letter. 9. Resident Permit Page if within China. (NO T visa) 10. Customs stamp page if previous in China

requirements.text: 1．Good physical and mental health (no infectious or contagious diseases and no physical or mental disorders that could interfere with regular study). 2．Applicants for master's program should be under 35 by September 1st, 2023. 3．Academic Requirement: As of September 1st, 2023, applicants for master's program must hold a bachelor's degree. 4. The applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.
